title: Operations Crew Charge Table: Crew Charge for Reconnecting Electric Service by Rate Schedule by Meter Type
content:
**Crew charge on reconnection.** The crew charge billed when an Electric Service by Rate Schedule account is reconnected after a nonpayment disconnection depends on the meter at the location, as recorded on the service account, and on whether a meter damage report — an outage or trouble report of meter damage — is dated less than one whole month before the current date on the same service account.

| Meter and reports | Crew charge |
|---|---|
| AMI remote-disconnect meter, and no meter damage report in the month | The schedule's remote reconnect figure |
| AMI demand meter with a current-transformer (CT) cabinet, or a meter damage report in the month (whatever the meter) | The schedule's after-hours truck figure, the rate of a two-person crew |
| Any other case | The schedule's business-hours truck figure |

### Figures by schedule

| Schedule | Remote figure | Business-hours truck figure | After-hours truck figure |
|---|---|---|---|
| Schedule R Residential Service | $25.00 | $75.00 | $150.00 |
| Schedule RS Seasonal Residential Service | $25.00 | $75.00 | $150.00 |
| Schedule FH Farm and Home Service | $25.00 | $75.00 | $150.00 |
| Schedule GS-1 Single-Phase General Service | $25.00 | $75.00 | $150.00 |
| Schedule GS-3 Three-Phase General Service | $25.00 | $110.00 | $210.00 |
| Schedule IR Irrigation Service | $25.00 | $110.00 | $210.00 |
| Schedule LP Large Power Service | $25.00 | $185.00 | $325.00 |

### Hypothetical cases

| Account | Meter | Meter damage report in the month | Crew charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| Schedule R home | AMI remote-disconnect | None | $25.00 |
| Schedule R home | AMI remote-disconnect | One, filed nine days ago | $150.00 |
| Schedule LP elevator | AMI demand with CT cabinet | None | $325.00 |
| Schedule GS-3 shop | Standard AMI meter without remote disconnect | None | $110.00 |
